usage: Common noun for a natural cave or rock洞 in a mountain area.
Often used for places you can visit, explore, or hide in; sounds natural in everyday Cantonese.
Can be used with verbs like 去, 入, 走入, 發現, and 參觀.
More concrete and physical than general words for “hole” or “cavern”; good for learners talking about nature and outdoor scenes.
